description: Defines the View class for rendering templates in the Goteo project, including view path management, rendering, and exception handling.

classes.name: View
classes.description: A class for managing and rendering view templates, handling view paths, variables, and exceptions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a View object with a filename and optional variables.

methods.name: addViewPath
methods.description: Adds a directory to the list of view paths.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets variables for the view, either from an array/object or key-value pair.

methods.name: getMIME
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the view, defaulting to 'text/html'.

methods.name: getViewPath
methods.description: Finds the full path to the view file, throws exception if not found and exception flag is true.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the view by including the view file and capturing output.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to create and render a view in one call.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the view to string by rendering it, catches exceptions to prevent errors.
